summary: Full regression on Uzlife (first-pass). Backend: 36/36 pytest cases pass (auth, profile, config, news CRUD + AI summary, places search/detail/photo, life reminders/plans/saved-places + ownership isolation, AI chat SSE streaming with places action, services, market CRUD, media/sign, admin login/stats/sources cycle/config toggle/listings). Frontend (390x844): auth login with test@uzlife.app succeeds, home renders greeting, Flash hero opens /flash, chat streams reply, places search action fires with mini-cards; bottom tabs home/explore/news/life all navigate; Explore search for 'plov' returns real Google Places results with photos; News list + hero render; Hidden admin unlocked by 5x profile-version tap, admin password 909463 logs in, overview/sources/features tabs all load with real data (website_url=https://uzlife.uz, all 5 features ON). Admin config was restored to all features=true, website_url=https://uzlife.uz, announcement="" after toggles. No deprecated expo packages (expo-av / barcode-scanner / background-fetch) present. No React Native red screens or console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORS middleware is added AFTER app.include_router(api); it still works for FastAPI but is unusual - consider adding middleware before include_router for consistency.
ai.py L119: 'except (json.JSONDecodeError, Exception)' - Exception already catches JSONDecodeError, duplicate clause is redundant.
life.py: list_reminders ordering uses 'done.asc,due_at.asc.nullslast,created_at.desc' - make sure the PostgREST nullslast syntax is supported by current Supabase version (verified via test, works).
admin.py: in-memory rate limiter _attempts dict is per-process; multi-worker deployments won't share state. Acceptable for single-pod but should be noted.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of flows exercised (login, Flash streaming, tabs navigation, Explore search, News list, hidden admin, admin login, admin tabs)

seed_data_creation: Transient test data created and cleaned up within tests: throwaway signup accounts (2) created and deleted; TEST_ prefixed reminders/plans/saved-places/listings/news sources all cleaned up. The test@uzlife.app account was preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_uzlife_api.py and is runnable with `pytest tests/test_uzlife_api.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/uzlife_results.xml`. Credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Admin login is rate-limited to 5 wrong attempts / 15min / IP - use at most 1 wrong attempt per run. Life FAB testID is `life-add-button` (not `life-fab`). Flash is a stack screen above tabs - navigate home before tapping tab buttons. Cloudinary upload failing is a known credential issue (user's secret is invalid) and must not be counted as an app bug; listing creation without photo works.
rca_of_issue: No bugs reproduced; nothing to RCA.
